scope: One affordable unlocked second vehicle plus one representative visual item, performance item, paint color, vehicle switch, free-roam return, and fresh-process persistence check.

phases.instruction: Enter any garage from saved free roam and stop on its stable main screen.
Purchase any affordable unlocked second vehicle and show its completed ownership/vehicle-management state.
Purchase and visibly apply one affordable visual customization item to the new vehicle.
Purchase and visibly confirm one affordable performance/tuning item.
Purchase and visibly apply a paint color clearly different from the vehicle's prior color.
Switch to the other owned vehicle and show the stable vehicle-management view.
Exit the garage in the selected vehicle, regain control, and wait for any saving indicator to finish.
Load saved free roam in this fresh process and re-enter any garage.
Show that the vehicle purchased in cycle 1 remains owned and selectable.
Show the cycle-1 visual customization and changed paint still applied to the purchased vehicle.
Switch between the two owned vehicles once more and show the stable result.
Exit to controllable free roam in the selected vehicle and wait for any saving indicator to finish.
